note: Machine-readable side of docs/genome/LICENCES.md. Software licences and data/service terms are recorded separately. Nothing here is a legal conclusion. 'commercialPilot' is 'approved' only after a named person has reviewed the current terms; until then every item is 'not-approved', and tools running in commercial-pilot mode refuse to use it.

items.name: Ensembl REST API (gene, transcript, sequence)
items.supplies: Gene coordinates (GRCh38), canonical transcript and exons, coding and genomic sequence, release number.
items.softwareLicence: Not applicable: only the public REST service is called; no Ensembl code is bundled.
items.dataTerms: Ensembl disclaimer; EMBL-EBI terms of use. Not verified from the authoritative pages (unreachable from the build environment).
items.attribution: Citation requested by Ensembl; confirm wording on the terms page.
items.redistribution: Raw responses are redistributed in public/vision/snapshot/. Confirm this is permitted.
items.followUp: Read the current disclaimer and EMBL-EBI terms; note any third-party data constraints the disclaimer mentions.

items.name: UniProtKB REST API
items.supplies: Reviewed protein entry: sequence, function, tissue, catalytic activity, cross-references (HGNC, Ensembl, Reactome, PDB).
items.softwareLicence: Not applicable: only the public REST service is called.
items.dataTerms: Indicated as CC BY 4.0 by secondary sources; not verified from the authoritative page.
items.attribution: If CC BY 4.0 is confirmed: attribution and a link to the licence are required.
items.redistribution: Raw responses are redistributed in public/vision/snapshot/. Confirm attribution is displayed alongside.
items.followUp: Confirm the licence and required attribution text; confirm cross-referenced content (e.g. Reactome names) carries no separate terms.

items.name: AlphaFold Protein Structure Database (API and model files)
items.supplies: Predicted structure coordinates and per-residue confidence (pLDDT).
items.softwareLicence: Not applicable: AlphaFold code and model parameters are not used or bundled.
items.dataTerms: Indicated as CC BY 4.0 with EMBL-EBI terms by secondary sources; not verified from the authoritative page. The API also links AlphaMissense annotation files, which are a separate component (see alphamissense) and are not used.
items.attribution: If CC BY 4.0 is confirmed: attribution and citation of the AlphaFold DB papers.
items.redistribution: A model file is redistributed in public/vision/snapshot/. Confirm this is permitted.
items.followUp: Read the licence disclaimer PDF and FAQ; keep model parameters and AlphaMissense out of scope unless separately reviewed.

items.name: NCBI ClinVar via E-utilities (esearch, esummary)
items.version: No release number in the response; snapshot retrieved 2026-10-20
items.supplies: Submitted variant records for a gene: HGVS, classification, review status, conditions, GRCh38 location.
items.softwareLicence: Not applicable: only the public E-utilities service is called.
items.dataTerms: NCBI policies and E-utilities usage guidelines. Government-created content is described as public domain by secondary sources, but ClinVar holds content submitted by third parties, which may carry its own rights. Not verified from the authoritative pages.
items.redistribution: Raw esummary batches are redistributed in public/vision/snapshot/. Needs legal review because of submitter content.
items.followUp: Legal review of reuse and redistribution of submitted records; confirm E-utilities rate limits and the tool/email parameters NCBI asks for.

items.name: HGNC REST service (genenames.org)
items.version: Recorded per capture (response timestamp); not yet captured
items.supplies: Authoritative approved gene symbol and HGNC ID, with Ensembl and UniProt cross-references, used to validate the gene registry.
items.softwareLicence: Not applicable: only the public REST service is called.
items.dataTerms: Indicated as CC0 by secondary sources; not verified from the authoritative page.
items.attribution: Citation recommended (not required if CC0 is confirmed).
items.redistribution: The HGNC response is saved in each gene's snapshot.
items.followUp: Confirm licence and REST usage limits.

items.name: RCSB PDB file service
items.version: Per entry; RPE65 has no experimental entry
items.supplies: Experimental structure coordinates, when UniProt cross-references one (Vision structure stage).
items.dataTerms: Shown in the app as CC0 1.0; not verified from the authoritative page.
items.attribution: Citation of the entry and RCSB PDB requested; confirm.
items.redistribution: Not redistributed: fetched live by the browser only.

items.name: zod
items.supplies: Schema validation of every source response.
items.attribution: Keep the MIT copyright and permission notice in distributions.
items.followUp: Named reviewer sign-off; confirm notices are shipped with the build.

items.name: Mol* (molstar)
items.supplies: 3D structure viewer for the predicted protein model.
items.attribution: Keep the MIT notice; Mol* asks that publications cite it.
items.followUp: Named reviewer sign-off; confirm notices are shipped with the build.

items.name: Python standard library (capture tool)
items.supplies: HTTP, gzip, hashing and JSON for tools/vision-snapshot/capture.py.
items.softwareLicence: PSF License (not re-checked in this review)
items.attribution: Not distributed: runs only in CI.
items.followUp: Confirm; low priority because nothing is distributed.

items.name: AlphaMissense pathogenicity predictions
items.supplies: Not used. Linked from AlphaFold DB API responses (amAnnotationsUrl); not downloaded or shown.
items.dataTerms: Not reviewed. Predictor scores are separately licensed and some predictors are distributed under non-commercial terms.
items.followUp: Review terms before any use; must not enter a commercial-pilot path until approved.

items.name: Other variant effect predictors (e.g. CADD, REVEL, SpliceAI, PolyPhen-2, SIFT)
items.supplies: Not used and not planned for Genome v1.
items.dataTerms: Not reviewed. Each predictor's scores and software must be reviewed separately; some may carry non-commercial or registration terms.
